'''Surlivan Sarat''' is a guard in the [[Tarasin Palace]] in [[Ebou Dar]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is stocky.

== Activities ==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] meets him on duty when he is about to enter the palace. He seems less than pleased when asked by [[Noal Charin]] about a group of [[Seanchan]] entering at the same time.
